 Heating Assistance Available: LIHEAP Appointments Open Soon Through Shawnee Development Council
 / WMOK 
 WMOK - Metropolis, IL 
 Oct 26, 2026 | 9:58 AM 
 WMOK – Metropolis, IL – As seasons shift and utility costs remain a primary concern for local households, assistance is around the corner for residents in Metropolis, Massac County, and neighboring areas. The Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) is preparing to open its upcoming round of scheduling to help eligible families manage the cost of home heating and cooling bills. 
 What Is LIHEAP?
 The Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) is a state and federally funded program designed to assist income-eligible households with energy costs. The program provides direct financial assistance toward utility bills, helping ensure that families, seniors, and individuals across southern Illinois can maintain safe and reliable power and heat in their homes.
 Important Dates and Appointments
 Appointments for the upcoming program period can be made beginning Monday, September 21 .
 Because funding and appointment slots fill quickly, local administrators encourage residents seeking assistance to prepare early and reach out promptly once scheduling opens.
 How to Apply & Get More Information
 Local administration for LIHEAP is handled through Shawnee Development Council, Inc. Community members are encouraged to contact their local office to learn more about eligibility guidelines, required documentation, and the application process.
 Massac County Office: 1 Superman Square, Metropolis, IL 
 Phone: (618) 524-2941
 Folks are encouraged to pass this information along to neighbors, family, and friends who may benefit from utility assistance as cooler weather approaches.
